checkpoint.goal: Maintain nulnul-harness as a verified personal agent system that completes projects and improves agents from independently tested feedback.
checkpoint.milestone: Navigator v3 is independently promoted and nulnul-harness 1.2.1 is packaged and release-verified.
checkpoint.completion_check: The 1.2.1 archive exactly matches the final plugin; all 31 tests, Release Gate, and evolution-state validation pass before push.
checkpoint.last_verified: The final 1.2.1 plugin and archive match; all 31 tests, Release Gate, archive integrity, evolution-state validation, and diff checks pass on 2026-08-10.
checkpoint.next_action: Commit and push the verified 1.2.1 release candidate to the existing PR, then confirm its checks.
approved_permissions: push the current feature branch and update the existing draft PR

navigator.job: Own the product outcome, verified checkpoint, permissions, resume, and final synthesis.

coach.job: Turn reproducible worker, user, test, and Gate feedback into one targeted upgrade proposal.

gate.job: Independently compare candidates with accepted versions and promote, reject, or roll back.

product-builder.job: Implement the smallest complete product change and leave executable verification.

feedback.observed: The evolution validator allowed contradictory promotion state and blank evidence, and malformed non-string ids could raise TypeError.
feedback.expected: Reject contradictory or evidence-free state and return validation errors for malformed input without crashing.
feedback.evidence: tests.test_personal_evolution reproduces proposal/promotion mismatch, empty evidence, and malformed ids.

feedback.observed: The default GitHub README was Korean-first and did not make the product, evidence boundary, and international onboarding immediately clear.
feedback.expected: Provide professional English and Korean entry points with the same version, installation, evidence, trust, and limitation claims.
feedback.evidence: README.md had no locale switch or equivalent English product guide before this candidate.

feedback.observed: The workflow could still enter capability discovery even when a repository already had sufficient instructions, capabilities, and completion checks.
feedback.expected: Reuse a coherent setup immediately and search only for uncovered jobs, stopping after one adequate verified candidate per job.
feedback.evidence: The previous core workflow called capability discovery unconditionally after repository inspection.

feedback.observed: The Korean README translated forward evaluation as an unnatural term that reduced professional clarity.
feedback.expected: Use a clear Korean rendering of forward evaluation without changing the verified claim.
feedback.evidence: Independent bilingual Gate rejected README.ko.md wording after all functional checks passed.

feedback.observed: The state validator rejected a valid agent after its second accepted promotion because it required every historical proposal to equal the current version.
feedback.expected: Validate accepted proposals as a continuous history and link the agent only to its latest accepted promotion.
feedback.evidence: Applying product-builder v3 made the repository state fail until a two-promotion regression reproduced and fixed the history rule.

feedback.observed: The validator prevented a target agent from approving itself but did not record or compare the proposal author with the Gate.
feedback.expected: Persist the proposal author and reject any promotion whose Gate authored the proposal.
feedback.evidence: The independent v4 Gate identified that author independence could only be inferred, not mechanically validated.

feedback.observed: nulnul-harness 1.2.0 activated for a self-contained local task and repeatedly loaded setup references even though the task already supplied explicit inputs, outputs, constraints, and a runnable completion check.
feedback.expected: Skip harness activation for complete isolated task contracts while retaining activation for external writes, capability discovery, multi-session checkpointing, and evolution.
feedback.evidence: evals/benchmarks/youtube-sheets/ab-results.json records 3/3 exact outputs in both arms with 30.51% median elapsed and 27.44% output-token overhead in the harness arm.

proposals.cause: The first validator checked required keys but did not fully enforce cross-record consistency or malformed value types.
proposals.change_target: Evolution state validator trust-boundary checks and focused regressions.
proposals.rollback: Restore product-builder v1 and the previous validator while retaining the failing forward-evaluation cases.

proposals.cause: The product documentation optimized for one language and exposed no deterministic locale consistency check.
proposals.change_target: Root English and Korean README onboarding plus locale consistency regression.
proposals.rollback: Restore the prior Korean README and remove README.ko.md plus its consistency regression.

proposals.cause: Repository inspection identified reusable setup, but discovery remained an unconditional later step.
proposals.change_target: Core workflow fast path and bounded capability-discovery stopping rule.
proposals.regression_check: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 -B scripts/release_gate.py
proposals.primary_metric: unnecessary setup and discovery steps on coherent repositories
proposals.rollback: Restore Navigator v1 and the previous unconditional discovery wording.

proposals.cause: The first bilingual candidate used an unnatural Korean term despite passing structural checks.
proposals.change_target: Bilingual onboarding with corrected Korean evaluation terminology.
proposals.rollback: Restore product-builder v2 and the prior Korean-only README.

proposals.cause: The validator treated each accepted proposal as the current version instead of validating ordered promotion history.
proposals.change_target: Accepted promotion-chain validation and latest-promotion linkage.
proposals.rollback: Restore product-builder v3 and the single-promotion validator while retaining the failing history regression.

proposals.cause: Proposal records identified the target but not the author, so Gate independence was not fully machine-checkable.
proposals.change_target: Proposal author persistence and author-versus-Gate validation.
proposals.rollback: Restore product-builder v4 and remove the author field while retaining the independence regression.

proposals.cause: The activation description excluded coherent repository setup but not a complete standalone task contract, so setup guidance was loaded without an uncovered job.
proposals.change_target: The nulnul-harness activation description only; no workflow, permission, capability, or product-file change.
proposals.regression_check: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v && python3 -B scripts/release_gate.py
proposals.primary_metric: median elapsed time and token use on self-contained local tasks
proposals.rollback: Restore Navigator v2 activation wording and retain the benchmark evidence.

promotions.before: A fresh evaluator reproduced three contract gaps in the initial validator.
promotions.after: Eight evolution regressions, all 24 automated tests, and Release Gate passed.

promotions.before: The bilingual candidate passed structural and functional checks.
promotions.after: The independent Gate found an unnatural Korean term that blocked professional release readiness.

promotions.before: Capability discovery remained an unconditional workflow step after repository inspection.
promotions.after: A fresh Gate confirmed coherent repositories take the direct path while uncovered jobs retain full candidate verification.

promotions.before: The first bilingual candidate was rejected for one unclear Korean term.
promotions.after: The corrected English and Korean onboarding passed independent review and all repository checks.

promotions.before: The validator rejected valid multi-promotion history and could not preserve rejected alternatives alongside later accepted versions.
promotions.after: A fresh Gate verified continuous history, rejected broken chains and self-approval, and confirmed latest-promotion linkage.

promotions.before: Gate independence could be inferred only from the target agent because proposal authors were not persisted.
promotions.after: A fresh Gate verified proposal-author persistence and rejection when the declared author also serves as Gate, without breaking valid history.

promotions.before: nulnul-harness 1.2.0 activated on a complete local task contract and added median time and token overhead without changing correctness.
promotions.after: A fresh Gate verified 3/3 exact candidate runs, 25.76% lower median elapsed time, lower token medians, two cross-task non-activation guards, and preserved ambiguous-project activation.
